{{Vanilla|Buried Treasure}}
'''Buried treasure''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest: the {{MCW|Heart of the Sea}} is removed, and the chest can contain a [[Trident]], [[Raw Diamond]]s, [[Nautilus Shell|nautilus shells]], [[The Divine Comedy]] or [[Paradise Lost]].
